# Third Party Libraries (`src/third_party`)

This directory contains external dependency libraries integrated directly into the Autolang build process.

## Libraries

- **`ankerl/`**: Fast associative hash maps (like `ankerl::unordered_dense::map`).
- **`curl/`**: Header and binding definitions for `libcurl` used by the HTTP standard library module.
- **`nlohmann/`**: Modern JSON parsing and serialization library.
- **`libs/`**: Static libraries or dynamic loader dependencies.
